# 1. Setup

Package calls and figure-specific definitions are retained with the original
figure blocks when moving them could alter exact reproducibility.

# 2. Data paths and loading

The notebook reads finalized analysis outputs. Machine-specific paths are
replaced only with existing repository-relative `../results/` paths.

# 3. Shared definitions

No new plotting abstraction is introduced. Existing figure-specific helpers are
preserved so the code corresponds directly to the manuscript figures.

# 4. Figure 1

## Reference sample size and Summix2 bias in Scenario 1

Figure 1 uses the uncorrected Scenario 1 simulations, in which all five
reference groups have the same reference sample size. Total absolute estimation error is
shown across simulation replicates for the African American-like, Latino-like,
and Peruvian-like simulated populations.

```{r figure1-config}
scenario1_dir <- Sys.getenv(
  "SCENARIO1_DIR",
  "../results/simulation/scenario_1_equal_sizes"
)

figure_dir <- Sys.getenv(
  "FIGURE_DIR",
  "../results/figures"
)

dir.create(
  figure_dir,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

figure1_sample_sizes <- c(5L,10L, 25L, 35L, 45L, 50L, 75L,
  100L, 150L, 250L, 500L, 750L, 1000L
)

group_labels <- c(
  AfricanAmerican = "African-American-like",
  Latinx = "Latino-like",
  Peruvian = "Peruvian-like"
)
```




```{r figure1-read-data}
if (!dir.exists(scenario1_dir)) {
  stop(
    "Scenario 1 results directory does not exist: ",
    scenario1_dir
  )
}

scenario1_files <- list.files(
  scenario1_dir,
  pattern = "\\.rds$",
  recursive = TRUE,
  full.names = TRUE
)

if (length(scenario1_files) == 0L) {
  stop(
    "No Scenario 1 .rds files were found in: ",
    scenario1_dir
  )
}

scenario1_results <- bind_rows(
  lapply(
    scenario1_files,
    readRDS
  )
)

required_columns <- c(
  "Group",
  "Replicate",
  "N_AFR",
  "N_EAS",
  "N_EUR",
  "N_IAM",
  "N_SAS",
  "total_absolute_deviation"
)

missing_columns <- setdiff(
  required_columns,
  names(scenario1_results)
)

if (length(missing_columns) > 0L) {
  stop(
    "Scenario 1 results are missing required columns: ",
    paste(missing_columns, collapse = ", ")
  )
}
```

```{r figure1-validate}
reference_size_columns <- c(
  "N_AFR",
  "N_EAS",
  "N_EUR",
  "N_IAM",
  "N_SAS"
)

equal_reference_sizes <- apply(
  scenario1_results[
    ,
    reference_size_columns,
    drop = FALSE
  ],
  1,
  function(x) {
    length(unique(x)) == 1L
  }
)

if (!all(equal_reference_sizes)) {
  stop(
    "One or more Scenario 1 rows do not have equal ",
    "reference sample sizes across all five reference groups."
  )
}

scenario1_results <- scenario1_results %>%
  mutate(
    reference_sample_size = N_AFR
  )

unexpected_groups <- setdiff(
  unique(scenario1_results$Group),
  names(group_labels)
)

if (length(unexpected_groups) > 0L) {
  stop(
    "Unexpected simulated population labels: ",
    paste(unexpected_groups, collapse = ", ")
  )
}
```

```{r figure1-prepare-data}
figure1_data <- scenario1_results %>%
  filter(
    reference_sample_size %in% figure1_sample_sizes
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    reference_sample_size = factor(
      reference_sample_size,
      levels = figure1_sample_sizes
    ),
    Group = factor(
      Group,
      levels = c(
        "AfricanAmerican",
        "Latinx",
        "Peruvian"
      ),
      labels = unname(
        group_labels[
          c(
            "AfricanAmerican",
            "Latinx",
            "Peruvian"
          )
        ]
      )
    )
  )

if (nrow(figure1_data) == 0L) {
  stop("No observations remained for Figure 1.")
}

replicate_check <- figure1_data %>%
  count(
    Group,
    reference_sample_size,
    name = "n_replicates"
  )

print(replicate_check)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(cowplot)

# ============================================================
# 5. Figure 2
# Effect of one varying reference group on Summix2 bias
# ============================================================


# ============================================================
# Configuration
# ============================================================

scenario23_dir <- Sys.getenv(
  "SCENARIO23_DIR",
  "../results/simulation/one_varying_reference"
)

reference_groups <- c(
  "AFR",
  "EAS",
  "EUR",
  "IAM",
  "SAS"
)

# Version D palette
reference_group_colors <- c(
  AFR = "#0072B2",
  EAS = "#00A6A6",
  EUR = "#45A778",
  IAM = "#B51E78",
  SAS = "#F28E2B"
)

total_bias_color <- "#37474F"


# ============================================================
# Read Scenario 2/3 simulation outputs
# ============================================================

if (!dir.exists(scenario23_dir)) {
  stop(
    "Scenario 2/3 results directory does not exist: ",
    scenario23_dir
  )
}

scenario23_files <- list.files(
  scenario23_dir,
  pattern = "\\.rds$",
  recursive = TRUE,
  full.names = TRUE
)

if (length(scenario23_files) == 0L) {
  stop(
    "No Scenario 2/3 .rds files were found in: ",
    scenario23_dir
  )
}

scenario23_results <- bind_rows(
  lapply(
    scenario23_files,
    readRDS
  )
)


# ============================================================
# Validate required columns
# ============================================================

required_columns <- c(
  "Scenario",
  "Group",
  "VaryingAncestry",
  "N_var",
  "N_fixed",
  "Replicate",
  paste0(
    "absolute_bias_",
    reference_groups
  ),
  "total_absolute_deviation"
)

missing_columns <- setdiff(
  required_columns,
  names(scenario23_results)
)

if (length(missing_columns) > 0L) {
  stop(
    "Scenario 2/3 results are missing required columns: ",
    paste(
      missing_columns,
      collapse = ", "
    )
  )
}


# ============================================================
# Figure 2 function
# ============================================================

make_figure2 <- function(
    simulation_results,
    target_group,
    target_scenario
) {

  # ==========================================================
  # Select simulation setting
  # ==========================================================
  display_sample_sizes <- c(
    5, 10, 25, 50, 100, 150, 250, 500
  )
  
  plot_data <- simulation_results %>%
    filter(
      Group == target_group,
      Scenario == target_scenario,
      N_var %in% display_sample_sizes
    )

  if (nrow(plot_data) == 0L) {
    stop(
      "No observations found for the selected population/scenario."
    )
  }


  # ==========================================================
  # Identify varying reference group
  # ==========================================================

  varying_reference_group <- unique(
    plot_data$VaryingAncestry
  )

  if (length(varying_reference_group) != 1L) {
    stop(
      "Expected exactly one varying reference group."
    )
  }


  # ==========================================================
  # Reference sample sizes
  # ==========================================================

  sample_sizes <- sort(
    unique(
      plot_data$N_var
    )
  )

  plot_data <- plot_data %>%
    mutate(
      N_plot = factor(
        N_var,
        levels = sample_sizes
      )
    )


  # ==========================================================
  # Convert reference-group-specific absolute estimation error
  # to long format
  # ==========================================================

  reference_group_bias_long <- plot_data %>%
    select(
      N_plot,
      N_var,
      Replicate,
      all_of(
        paste0(
          "absolute_bias_",
          reference_groups
        )
      )
    ) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = all_of(
        paste0(
          "absolute_bias_",
          reference_groups
        )
      ),
      names_to = "ReferenceGroup",
      names_prefix = "absolute_bias_",
      values_to = "AbsoluteBias"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      ReferenceGroup = factor(
        ReferenceGroup,
        levels = reference_groups
      )
    )


  # ==========================================================
  # Panel A data
  # ==========================================================

  varying_bias <- reference_group_bias_long %>%
    filter(
      as.character(
        ReferenceGroup
      ) == varying_reference_group
    )


  # ==========================================================
  # Panel B data
  # ==========================================================

  other_bias <- reference_group_bias_long %>%
    filter(
      as.character(
        ReferenceGroup
      ) != varying_reference_group
    )


  # ==========================================================
  # Panel C data
  # ==========================================================

  total_bias <- plot_data %>%
    transmute(
      N_plot,
      N_var,
      Replicate,
      TotalAbsoluteBias =
        total_absolute_deviation
    )


  # ==========================================================
  # Fixed y-axis scales
  # ==========================================================

  common_bias_y_scale <- scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = seq(
      0,
      0.40,
      by = 0.10
    ),
    expand = expansion(
      mult = c(
        0,
        0.02
      )
    )
  )

  total_bias_y_scale <- scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = seq(
      0,
      0.40,
      by = 0.10
    ),
    expand = expansion(
      mult = c(
        0,
        0.02
      )
    )
  )


  # ==========================================================
  # Shared x-axis
  # ==========================================================

  common_x_scale <- scale_x_discrete(
    limits = as.character(
      sample_sizes
    ),
    drop = FALSE
  )


  # ==========================================================
  # Theme
  # Thin horizontal grid lines only
  # ==========================================================

  figure2_theme <- theme_classic(
    base_size = 14
  ) +
    theme(
  
      # Thin horizontal grid lines
      panel.grid.major.y = element_line(
        color = "grey90",
        linewidth = 0.35
      ),
  
      # Thin vertical grid lines
      panel.grid.major.x = element_line(
        color = "grey90",
        linewidth = 0.35
      ),
  
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
  
      axis.line = element_line(
        color = "black",
        linewidth = 0.5
      ),
  
      axis.title.x = element_blank(),
  
      axis.title.y = element_text(
        size = 20,
        face = "bold",
        margin = margin(r = 10)
      ),
  
      axis.text.x = element_text(
        size = 17,
        angle = 45,
        hjust = 1,
        vjust = 1,
        face = "bold"
      ),
  
      axis.text.y = element_text(
        size = 17,
        face = "bold"
      ),
  
      plot.title = element_text(
        size = 17,
        face = "bold",
        hjust = 0.5,
        margin = margin(b = 8)
      ),
  
      legend.position = "none",
  
      plot.background = element_rect(
        fill = "white",
        color = NA
      ),
  
      panel.background = element_rect(
        fill = "white",
        color = NA
      )
    )


  # ==========================================================
  # Panel A
  # ==========================================================

  panel_a <- ggplot(
    varying_bias,
    aes(
      x = N_plot,
      y = AbsoluteBias,
      fill = ReferenceGroup,
      color = ReferenceGroup
    )
  ) +

    geom_boxplot(
      width = 0.70,
      linewidth = 0.40,
      outlier.size = 0.50,
      outlier.alpha = 0.35,
      alpha = 0.85
    ) +

    geom_hline(
      yintercept = 0.05,
      linetype = "dashed",
      linewidth = 0.50,
      color = "black"
    ) +

    common_x_scale +
    common_bias_y_scale +

    coord_cartesian(
      ylim = c(
        0,
        0.40
      )
    ) +

    scale_fill_manual(
      values = reference_group_colors,
      guide = "none"
    ) +

    scale_color_manual(
      values = reference_group_colors,
      guide = "none"
    ) +

    labs(
      title = paste0(
        "A. ",
        varying_reference_group,
        " reference group estimation error"
      ),
      x = NULL,
      y = "Absolute estimation error"
    ) +

    figure2_theme


  # ==========================================================
  # Panel B
  # ==========================================================

  panel_b <- ggplot(
    other_bias,
    aes(
      x = N_plot,
      y = AbsoluteBias,
      fill = ReferenceGroup,
      color = ReferenceGroup
    )
  ) +

    geom_boxplot(
      position = position_dodge2(
        width = 0.90,
        preserve = "single"
      ),
      width = 0.80,
      linewidth = 0.45,
      outlier.size = 0.40,
      outlier.alpha = 0.30,
      alpha = 0.85
    ) +

    geom_hline(
      yintercept = 0.05,
      linetype = "dashed",
      linewidth = 0.50,
      color = "black"
    ) +

    common_x_scale +
    common_bias_y_scale +

    coord_cartesian(
      ylim = c(
        0,
        0.40
      )
    ) +

    scale_fill_manual(
      values = reference_group_colors,
      guide = "none"
    ) +

    scale_color_manual(
      values = reference_group_colors,
      guide = "none"
    ) +

    labs(
      title = "B. Estimation error in other reference groups",
      x = NULL,
      y = NULL
    ) +

    figure2_theme +

    theme(
      axis.text.y = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.y = element_blank()
    )


  # ==========================================================
  # Panel C
  # ==========================================================

  panel_c <- ggplot(
    total_bias,
    aes(
      x = N_plot,
      y = TotalAbsoluteBias
    )
  ) +

    geom_boxplot(
      width = 0.70,
      linewidth = 0.40,
      outlier.size = 0.50,
      outlier.alpha = 0.35,
      alpha = 0.85,
      fill = total_bias_color,
      color = total_bias_color
    ) +

    geom_hline(
      yintercept = 0.05,
      linetype = "dashed",
      linewidth = 0.50,
      color = "black"
    ) +

    common_x_scale +
    total_bias_y_scale +

    coord_cartesian(
      ylim = c(
        0,
        0.40
      )
    ) +

    labs(
      title = "C. Total absolute estimation error",
      x = NULL,
      y = "Total absolute estimation error"
    ) +

    figure2_theme


  # ==========================================================
  # Main three-panel layout
  # ==========================================================

  main_panels <- (
    panel_a |
      panel_b |
      panel_c
  ) +
    plot_layout(
      widths = c(
        1,
        1,
        1
      )
    )


  # ==========================================================
  # Shared x-axis title
  # ==========================================================

  x_axis_title <- ggplot() +

    annotate(
      "text",
      x = 0,
      y = 0,
      label = paste0(
        "Varying ",
        varying_reference_group,
        " reference sample size (N)"
      ),
      size = 6,
      fontface = "bold"
    ) +

    xlim(
      -1,
      1
    ) +

    ylim(
      -1,
      1
    ) +

    theme_void()


  # ==========================================================
  # Dedicated legend
  #
  # Uses all five reference groups so IAM is always shown.
  # ==========================================================

  legend_data <- data.frame(
    ReferenceGroup = factor(
      reference_groups,
      levels = reference_groups
    ),
    x = seq_along(
      reference_groups
    ),
    y = 1
  )


  legend_plot <- ggplot(
    legend_data,
    aes(
      x = x,
      y = y,
      fill = ReferenceGroup
    )
  ) +

    geom_tile() +

    scale_fill_manual(
      values = reference_group_colors,
      limits = reference_groups,
      breaks = reference_groups,
      labels = reference_groups,
      drop = FALSE
    ) +

    guides(
      fill = guide_legend(
        title = "Reference group",
        nrow = 1,
        byrow = TRUE,
        override.aes = list(
          alpha = 0.85
        )
      )
    ) +
    

    theme_void() +
    

    theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",

      legend.title = element_text(
        size = 14,
        face = "bold"
      ),

      legend.text = element_text(
        size = 13
      )
    )


  legend_only <- cowplot::get_legend(
    legend_plot
  )


  # ==========================================================
  # Final Figure 2
  #
  # Order:
  #   panels
  #   shared x-axis title
  #   legend
  # ==========================================================

  figure2 <- (
    main_panels /
      x_axis_title /
      wrap_elements(
        legend_only
      )
  ) +

    plot_layout(
      heights = c(
        1,
        0.07,
        0.10
      )
    )


  figure2
}
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# 6. Figure 3
# Reference-sample-size correction performance across simulation scenarios
# ============================================================

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Configuration
# ------------------------------------------------------------

correction_dir <- Sys.getenv(
  "CORRECTION_DIR",
  "../results/correction"
)

figure_dir <- Sys.getenv(
  "FIGURE_DIR",
  "../results/figures"
)

dir.create(
  figure_dir,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

reference_groups <- c(
  "AFR",
  "EAS",
  "EUR",
  "IAM",
  "SAS"
)

display_sample_sizes <- c(
  5, 10, 25, 50, 100, 150, 250, 500
)

group_labels <- c(
  AfricanAmerican = "African-American-like",
  Latinx = "Latino-like",
  Peruvian = "Peruvian-like"
)

scenario_labels <- c(
  scenario_1_equal_sizes = "Scenario 1",
  scenario_2_one_varying_fixed_500 = "Scenario 2",
  scenario_3_one_varying_fixed_150 = "Scenario 3"
)

method_colors <- c(
  "Uncorrected" = "#555555",
  "1/N" = "#1B9E77",
  "a/N^b" = "#D95F02"
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Read corrected simulation results
# ------------------------------------------------------------

if (!dir.exists(correction_dir)) {
  stop(
    "Correction directory does not exist: ",
    correction_dir
  )
}

correction_files <- list.files(
  correction_dir,
  pattern = "\\.rds$",
  recursive = TRUE,
  full.names = TRUE
)

# Exclude evaluation/summary files if they are stored
# inside the same directory.
correction_files <- correction_files[
  !grepl(
    "comparison|summary|evaluation",
    basename(correction_files),
    ignore.case = TRUE
  )
]

if (length(correction_files) == 0L) {
  stop(
    "No corrected simulation .rds files found in: ",
    correction_dir
  )
}

corrected_results <- bind_rows(
  lapply(
    correction_files,
    readRDS
  )
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Validate required columns
# ------------------------------------------------------------

required_columns <- c(
  "Scenario",
  "Group",
  "Replicate",
  "N_AFR",
  "total_absolute_deviation",
  "linear_total_absolute_deviation",
  "powerlaw_total_absolute_deviation"
)

missing_columns <- setdiff(
  required_columns,
  names(corrected_results)
)

if (length(missing_columns) > 0L) {
  stop(
    "Corrected results are missing required columns: ",
    paste(
      missing_columns,
      collapse = ", "
    )
  )
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Determine reference sample size for each scenario
# ------------------------------------------------------------

corrected_results <- corrected_results %>%
  mutate(
    reference_sample_size = case_when(
      Scenario == "scenario_1_equal_sizes" ~ N_AFR,

      Scenario %in% c(
        "scenario_2_one_varying_fixed_500",
        "scenario_3_one_varying_fixed_150"
      ) ~ N_var,

      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  )

if (anyNA(corrected_results$reference_sample_size)) {
  stop(
    "Unable to determine reference sample size for one or more rows."
  )
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Convert correction methods to long format
# ------------------------------------------------------------

figure3_data <- corrected_results %>%
  filter(
    reference_sample_size %in% display_sample_sizes,
    Scenario %in% names(scenario_labels),
    Group %in% names(group_labels)
  ) %>%
  select(
    Scenario,
    Group,
    Replicate,
    reference_sample_size,
    total_absolute_deviation,
    linear_total_absolute_deviation,
    powerlaw_total_absolute_deviation
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(
      total_absolute_deviation,
      linear_total_absolute_deviation,
      powerlaw_total_absolute_deviation
    ),
    names_to = "Method",
    values_to = "TotalAbsoluteBias"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Method = recode(
      Method,
      total_absolute_deviation =
        "Uncorrected",
      linear_total_absolute_deviation =
        "1/N",
      powerlaw_total_absolute_deviation =
        "a/N^b"
    ),

    Method = factor(
      Method,
      levels = c(
        "Uncorrected",
        "1/N",
        "a/N^b"
      )
    ),

    Group = factor(
      Group,
      levels = names(group_labels),
      labels = unname(group_labels)
    ),

    Scenario = factor(
      Scenario,
      levels = names(scenario_labels),
      labels = unname(scenario_labels)
    ),

    reference_sample_size = factor(
      reference_sample_size,
      levels = display_sample_sizes
    )
  )

if (nrow(figure3_data) == 0L) {
  stop(
    "No observations remained for Figure 3."
  )
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Optional replicate-count check
# ------------------------------------------------------------

replicate_check <- figure3_data %>%
  count(
    Scenario,
    Group,
    reference_sample_size,
    Method,
    name = "n_replicates"
  )

print(
  replicate_check
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Figure 3
# ------------------------------------------------------------

figure3 <- ggplot(
  figure3_data,
  aes(
    x = reference_sample_size,
    y = TotalAbsoluteBias,
    fill = Method,
    color = Method
  )
) +

  # Shade low-reference regime: N <= 150
  annotate(
    "rect",
    xmin = 0.5,
    xmax = 6.5,
    ymin = -Inf,
    ymax = Inf,
    fill = "#F3F7FA",
    alpha = 0.45
  ) +

  geom_boxplot(
    position = position_dodge2(
      width = 0.88,
      preserve = "single"
    ),
    width = 0.72,
    linewidth = 0.40,
    outlier.size = 0.30,
    outlier.alpha = 0.25,
    alpha = 0.85
  ) +

  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0.05,
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.50,
    color = "black"
  ) +

  facet_grid(
    Scenario ~ Group
  ) +

  scale_fill_manual(
    values = method_colors,
    labels = c(
      "Uncorrected" = "Uncorrected Summix2",
      "1/N" = expression(frac(1, N) ~ "correction"),
      "a/N^b" = expression(frac(a, N^b) ~ "correction")
    )
  ) +

  scale_color_manual(
    values = method_colors,
    labels = c(
      "Uncorrected" = "Uncorrected Summix2",
      "1/N" = expression(frac(1, N) ~ "correction"),
      "a/N^b" = expression(frac(a, N^b) ~ "correction")
    )
  ) +

  labs(
    x = "Reference sample size (N)",
    y = "Total absolute estimation error",
    fill = NULL,
    color = NULL
  ) +

  theme_classic(
    base_size = 14
  ) +

  theme(
  panel.grid.major.y = element_line(
    color = "grey90",
    linewidth = 0.35
  ),

  panel.grid.major.x = element_line(
    color = "grey94",
    linewidth = 0.3
  ),

  panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),

  panel.border = element_rect(
    color = "grey65",

  ),

  panel.spacing.x = unit(

  ),

  panel.spacing.y = unit(

  ),

  strip.background = element_blank(),

    size = 15,

  ),

    size = 13

)

figure3
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Real-data figures
#
# Plot 1:
#   Jointly limited reference sample sizes
#
# Plot 2:
#   AFR reference sample size varies
#
# Aesthetic matched to Figure 2:
#   - theme_classic()
#   - horizontal grid lines only
#   - white background
#   - bold facet titles
#   - no facet-strip boxes
#   - points only
#   - fixed y-axis across all panels
# ============================================================

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# ============================================================
# Read evaluated real-data results
# ============================================================

real_eval <- readRDS(
  "../results/real_data/real_data_correction_evaluation_long.rds"
)

# ============================================================
# Configuration
# ============================================================

display_sample_sizes <- c(
  5, 15, 25, 35, 45,
  75, 100, 150, 250, 500
)

reference_groups <- c(
  "AFR",
  "EUR",
  "IAM",
  "SAS",
  "EAS"
)

panel_order <- c(
  "AFR",
  "EUR",
  "IAM",
  "SAS",
  "EAS",
  "Total absolute deviation from benchmark"
)

method_levels <- c(
  "Uncorrected",
  "1/N",
  "a/N^b"
)

method_colors <- c(
  "Uncorrected" = "#4D4D4D",
  "1/N"         = "#1B9E77",
  "a/N^b"       = "#D95F02"
)

method_labels <- c(
  "Uncorrected" = "Uncorrected Summix2",
  "1/N"         = expression(frac(1, N) ~ "correction"),
  "a/N^b"       = expression(frac(a, N^b) ~ "correction")
)

# ============================================================
# Shared plotting function
# ============================================================

make_real_data_plot <- function(
    evaluation,
    stress_test,
    x_axis_title
) {

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Select stress test
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  selected <- evaluation %>%
    filter(
      StressTest == stress_test,
      ReferenceSampleSize %in% display_sample_sizes
    )

  if (nrow(selected) == 0L) {
    stop(
      "No rows found for stress test: ",
      stress_test
    )
  }

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Ancestry estimate panels
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  ancestry_data <- selected %>%
    filter(
      ReferenceGroup %in% reference_groups
    ) %>%
    transmute(
      ReferenceSampleSize,
      Method = as.character(Method),
      Panel = as.character(ReferenceGroup),
      Value = Estimate,
      BenchmarkEstimate
    )

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Total absolute deviation panel
  #
  # TotalAbsoluteDeviation is repeated once for each ancestry,
  # so retain one row per N × Method.
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  total_data <- selected %>%
    distinct(
      ReferenceSampleSize,
      Method,
      TotalAbsoluteDeviation
    ) %>%
    transmute(
      ReferenceSampleSize,
      Method = as.character(Method),
      Panel = "Total absolute deviation from benchmark",
      Value = TotalAbsoluteDeviation,
      BenchmarkEstimate = 0
    )

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Combine all six panels
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  plot_data <- bind_rows(
    ancestry_data,
    total_data
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      ReferenceSampleSize = factor(
        ReferenceSampleSize,
        levels = display_sample_sizes
      ),

      Method = factor(
        Method,
        levels = method_levels
      ),

      Panel = factor(
        Panel,
        levels = panel_order
      )
    )

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Benchmark lines
  #
  # Ancestry panels:
  #   large-reference benchmark estimate
  #
  # Total panel:
  #   zero total deviation
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  benchmark_data <- plot_data %>%
    distinct(
      Panel,
      BenchmarkEstimate
    )

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Plot
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  ggplot(
    plot_data,
    aes(
      x = ReferenceSampleSize,
      y = Value,
      color = Method
    )
  ) +

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Benchmark line
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    geom_hline(
      data = benchmark_data,
      aes(
        yintercept = BenchmarkEstimate
      ),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      linetype = "dashed",
      linewidth = 0.50,
      color = "black"
    ) +

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Points
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    geom_point(
      size = 2.4,
      alpha = 0.95,
      position = position_dodge(
        width = 0.35
      )
    ) +

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Facets
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    facet_wrap(
      ~ Panel,
      ncol = 3,
      scales = "fixed"
    ) +

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Fixed y-axis
    #
    # Slightly below 0 so SAS and Total benchmark lines
    # at y = 0 remain visible.
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    scale_y_continuous(
      limits = c(
        -0.02,
        0.90
      ),
      breaks = c(
        0,
        0.2,
        0.4,
        0.6,
        0.8
      ),
      expand = expansion(
        mult = c(
          0,
          0.02
        )
      )
    ) +

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Method colors
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    scale_color_manual(
      values = method_colors,
      breaks = method_levels,
      labels = method_labels,
      drop = FALSE
    ) +

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Labels
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    labs(
      x = x_axis_title,
      y = "Estimate / total absolute deviation",
      color = NULL
    ) +

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Figure 2-style theme
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    theme_classic(
      base_size = 14
    ) +

    theme(

     # thin horizontal and vertical grid lines
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(
      color = "grey90",
      linewidth = 0.35
    ),
    
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(
      color = "grey90",
      linewidth = 0.35
    ),
    
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),

      # axes
      axis.line = element_line(
        color = "black",
        linewidth = 0.5
      ),

      axis.title.x = element_text(
        size = 18,
        face = "bold",
        margin = margin(
          t = 10
        )
      ),

      axis.title.y = element_text(
        size = 18,
        face = "bold",
        margin = margin(
          r = 10
        )
      ),

      axis.text.x = element_text(
        size = 13,
        angle = 45,
        hjust = 1,
        vjust = 1,
        face = "bold"
      ),

      axis.text.y = element_text(
        size = 13,
        face = "bold"
      ),

      # facet titles
      strip.background = element_blank(),

      strip.text = element_text(
        size = 16,
        face = "bold"
      ),

      # legend
      legend.position = "bottom",

      legend.title = element_blank(),

      legend.text = element_text(
        size = 12
      ),

      legend.key.width = unit(
        0.8,
        "cm"
      ),

      # white manuscript background
      plot.background = element_rect(
        fill = "white",
        color = NA
      ),

      panel.background = element_rect(
        fill = "white",
        color = NA
      )
    )
}

# ============================================================
# Plot 1
# Real data: jointly limited references
#
# N <= 45:
#   AFR/EUR/IAM/SAS/EAS all use N
#
# N > 45:
#   AFR/EUR/SAS/EAS continue increasing
#   IAM remains capped at N = 45
# ============================================================

real_data_joint_plot <- make_real_data_plot(
  evaluation = real_eval,
  stress_test = "jointly_limited",
  x_axis_title = "Reference sample size (N)"
)

real_data_joint_plot

# ============================================================
# Plot 2
# Real data: AFR varies
#
# AFR = 5 ... 500
# EUR/EAS/SAS = 500
# IAM = 45
# ============================================================

real_data_vary_afr_plot <- make_real_data_plot(
  evaluation = real_eval,
  stress_test = "vary_AFR",
  x_axis_title = "AFR reference sample size (N)"
)

real_data_vary_afr_plot

# ============================================================
# Save real-data figures (Figure 4A and Figure 4B)
# ============================================================

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(figure_dir, "Figure_4A_real_data_jointly_limited.pdf"),
  plot = real_data_joint_plot,
  width = 14,
  height = 10
)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(figure_dir, "Figure_4A_real_data_jointly_limited.png"),
  plot = real_data_joint_plot,
  width = 14,
  height = 10,
  dpi = 300
)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(figure_dir, "Figure_4B_real_data_vary_AFR.pdf"),
  plot = real_data_vary_afr_plot,
  width = 14,
  height = 10
)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(figure_dir, "Figure_4B_real_data_vary_AFR.png"),
  plot = real_data_vary_afr_plot,
  width = 14,
  height = 10,
  dpi = 300
)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# 9. Supplementary Figure S1
# Scenario 1: reference-group-specific absolute estimation error

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

correction_dir <- "../results/correction"
figure_dir <- "../results/figures"

dir.create(
  figure_dir,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Settings
# ------------------------------------------------------------

reference_groups <- c(
  "AFR", "EAS", "EUR", "IAM", "SAS"
)

display_sample_sizes <- c(
  5, 10, 25, 50, 100, 150, 250, 500
)

group_labels <- c(
  AfricanAmerican = "African-American-like",
  Latinx = "Latino-like",
  Peruvian = "Peruvian-like"
)

method_levels <- c(
  "Uncorrected",
  "1/N",
  "a/N^b"
)

method_colors <- c(
  "Uncorrected" = "#555555",
  "1/N" = "#1B9E77",
  "a/N^b" = "#D95F02"
)

method_labels <- c(
  "Uncorrected" = "Uncorrected Summix2",
  "1/N" = expression(frac(1, N) ~ "correction"),
  "a/N^b" = expression(frac(a, N^b) ~ "correction")
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Read corrected simulation results
# ------------------------------------------------------------

correction_files <- list.files(
  correction_dir,
  pattern = "\\.rds$",
  recursive = TRUE,
  full.names = TRUE
)

correction_files <- correction_files[
  !grepl(
    "comparison|summary|evaluation",
    basename(correction_files),
    ignore.case = TRUE
  )
]

corrected_results <- bind_rows(
  lapply(correction_files, readRDS)
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Scenario 1 only
# ------------------------------------------------------------

scenario1_results <- corrected_results %>%
  filter(
    Scenario == "scenario_1_equal_sizes",
    Group %in% names(group_labels),
    N_AFR %in% display_sample_sizes
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Convert reference-group-specific bias to long format
# ------------------------------------------------------------

s1_long <- scenario1_results %>%
  select(
    Group,
    Replicate,
    N_AFR,
    matches(
      "^(absolute_bias_|linear_absolute_bias_|powerlaw_absolute_bias_)(AFR|EAS|EUR|IAM|SAS)$"
    )
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(Group, Replicate, N_AFR),
    names_to = "BiasVariable",
    values_to = "AbsoluteBias"
  ) %>%
  mutate(

    # Correction method
    Method = case_when(
      grepl("^linear_absolute_bias_", BiasVariable) ~ "1/N",
      grepl("^powerlaw_absolute_bias_", BiasVariable) ~ "a/N^b",
      grepl("^absolute_bias_", BiasVariable) ~ "Uncorrected"
    ),

    # Reference group
    ReferenceGroup = sub(
      "^(linear_|powerlaw_)?absolute_bias_",
      "",
      BiasVariable
    ),

    Method = factor(
      Method,
      levels = method_levels
    ),

    ReferenceGroup = factor(
      ReferenceGroup,
      levels = reference_groups
    ),

    Group = factor(
      Group,
      levels = names(group_labels),
      labels = unname(group_labels)
    ),

    ReferenceSampleSize = factor(
      N_AFR,
      levels = display_sample_sizes
    )
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Supplementary Figure S1
# ------------------------------------------------------------

supplement_figure_s1 <- ggplot(
  s1_long,
  aes(
    x = ReferenceSampleSize,
    y = AbsoluteBias,
    fill = Method,
    color = Method
  )
) +

  # Low-reference regime: N <= 150
  annotate(
    "rect",
    xmin = 0.5,
    xmax = 6.5,
    ymin = -Inf,
    ymax = Inf,
    fill = "#F3F7FA",
    alpha = 0.45
  ) +

  geom_boxplot(
    position = position_dodge2(
      width = 0.88,
      preserve = "single"
    ),
    width = 0.72,
    linewidth = 0.40,
    outlier.size = 0.25,
    outlier.alpha = 0.20,
    alpha = 0.85
  ) +

  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0.05,
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.50,
    color = "black"
  ) +

  # Rows = reference groups
  # Columns = simulated admixed populations
  facet_grid(
    ReferenceGroup ~ Group
  ) +

  scale_fill_manual(
    values = method_colors,
    breaks = method_levels,
    labels = method_labels,
    drop = FALSE
  ) +

  scale_color_manual(
    values = method_colors,
    breaks = method_levels,
    labels = method_labels,
    drop = FALSE
  ) +

  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = seq(0, 0.70, by = 0.10),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))
  ) +

  # Display range only — does not remove observations
  coord_cartesian(
    ylim = c(0, 0.70)
  ) +

  labs(
    x = "Reference sample size (N)",
    y = "Absolute estimation error",
    fill = NULL,
    color = NULL
  ) +

  theme_classic(
    base_size = 14
  ) +

  theme(
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(
      color = "grey90",
      linewidth = 0.35
    ),

    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(
      color = "grey94",
      linewidth = 0.30
    ),

    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),

    panel.border = element_rect(
      color = "grey65",
      fill = NA,
      linewidth = 0.45
    ),

    panel.spacing.x = grid::unit(
      0.65,
      "lines"
    ),

    panel.spacing.y = grid::unit(
      0.45,
      "lines"
    ),

    strip.background = element_blank(),

    strip.text.x = element_text(
      size = 15,
      face = "bold"
    ),

    strip.text.y = element_text(
      size = 14,
      face = "bold"
    ),

    axis.title.x = element_text(
      size = 20,
      face = "bold",
      margin = margin(t = 10)
    ),

    axis.title.y = element_text(
      size = 20,
      face = "bold",

    ),

    axis.text.x = element_text(
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# 10. Supplementary Figure S2
# Scenario 2:
# One reference group varies;
# remaining reference groups fixed at N = 500
# ============================================================

scenario2_results <- corrected_results %>%
  filter(
    grepl(
      "scenario[_ -]?2",
      Scenario,
      ignore.case = TRUE
    ),
    Group %in% names(group_labels)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    N_var = case_when(
      Group == "AfricanAmerican" ~ N_AFR,
      Group == "Latinx" ~ N_IAM,
      Group == "Peruvian" ~ N_IAM,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(
    N_var %in% display_sample_sizes
  )

if (nrow(scenario2_results) == 0L) {
  stop("No Scenario 2 corrected results were found.")
}

# ============================================================
# Convert reference-group-specific biases to long format
# ============================================================

s2_long <- scenario2_results %>%
  select(
    Group,
    Replicate,
    N_var,
    matches(
      "^(absolute_bias_|linear_absolute_bias_|powerlaw_absolute_bias_)(AFR|EAS|EUR|IAM|SAS)$"
    )
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(
      Group,
      Replicate,
      N_var
    ),
    names_to = "BiasVariable",
    values_to = "AbsoluteBias"
  ) %>%
  mutate(

    Method = case_when(
      grepl(
        "^linear_absolute_bias_",
        BiasVariable
      ) ~ "1/N",

      grepl(
        "^powerlaw_absolute_bias_",
        BiasVariable
      ) ~ "a/N^b",

      grepl(
        "^absolute_bias_",
        BiasVariable
      ) ~ "Uncorrected",

      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    ReferenceGroup = BiasVariable,

    ReferenceGroup = sub(
      "^linear_absolute_bias_",
      "",
      ReferenceGroup
    ),

    ReferenceGroup = sub(
      "^powerlaw_absolute_bias_",
      "",
      ReferenceGroup
    ),

    ReferenceGroup = sub(
      "^absolute_bias_",
      "",
      ReferenceGroup
    )
  )

    Method = factor(

    ),

  )
```

# 7. Figure 4A

# 8. Figure 4B

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Real-data figures
#
# Plot 1:
#   Jointly limited reference sample sizes
#
# Plot 2:
#   AFR reference sample size varies
#
# Aesthetic matched to Figure 2:
#   - theme_classic()
#   - horizontal grid lines only
#   - white background
#   - bold facet titles
#   - no facet-strip boxes
#   - points only
#   - fixed y-axis across all panels
# ============================================================

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# ============================================================
# Read evaluated real-data results
# ============================================================

real_eval <- readRDS(
  "../results/real_data/real_data_correction_evaluation_long.rds"
)

# ============================================================
# Configuration
# ============================================================

display_sample_sizes <- c(
  5, 15, 25, 35, 45,
  75, 100, 150, 250, 500
)

reference_groups <- c(
  "AFR",
  "EUR",
  "IAM",
  "SAS",
  "EAS"
)

panel_order <- c(
  "AFR",
  "EUR",
  "IAM",
  "SAS",
  "EAS",
  "Total absolute deviation from benchmark"
)

method_levels <- c(
  "Uncorrected",
  "1/N",
  "a/N^b"
)

method_colors <- c(
  "Uncorrected" = "#4D4D4D",
  "1/N"         = "#1B9E77",
  "a/N^b"       = "#D95F02"
)

method_labels <- c(
      "Uncorrected" = "Uncorrected Summix2",
      "1/N" = expression(frac(1, N) ~ "correction"),
      "a/N^b" = expression(frac(a, N^b) ~ "correction")
)

# ============================================================
# Shared plotting function
# ============================================================

make_real_data_plot <- function(
    evaluation,
    stress_test,
    x_axis_title
) {

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Select stress test
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  selected <- evaluation %>%
    filter(
      StressTest == stress_test,
      ReferenceSampleSize %in% display_sample_sizes
    )

  if (nrow(selected) == 0L) {
    stop(
      "No rows found for stress test: ",
      stress_test
    )
  }

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Ancestry estimate panels
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  ancestry_data <- selected %>%
    filter(
      ReferenceGroup %in% reference_groups
    ) %>%
    transmute(
      ReferenceSampleSize,
      Method = as.character(Method),
      Panel = as.character(ReferenceGroup),
      Value = Estimate,
      BenchmarkEstimate
    )

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Total absolute deviation panel
  #
  # TotalAbsoluteDeviation is repeated once for each ancestry,
  # so retain one row per N × Method.
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  total_data <- selected %>%
    distinct(
      ReferenceSampleSize,
      Method,
      TotalAbsoluteDeviation
    ) %>%
    transmute(
      ReferenceSampleSize,
      Method = as.character(Method),
      Panel = "Total absolute deviation from benchmark",
      Value = TotalAbsoluteDeviation,
      BenchmarkEstimate = 0
    )

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Combine all six panels
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  plot_data <- bind_rows(
    ancestry_data,
    total_data
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      ReferenceSampleSize = factor(
        ReferenceSampleSize,
        levels = display_sample_sizes
      ),

      Method = factor(
        Method,
        levels = method_levels
      ),

      Panel = factor(
        Panel,
        levels = panel_order
      )
    )

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Benchmark lines
  #
  # Ancestry panels:
  #   large-reference benchmark estimate
  #
  # Total panel:
  #   zero total deviation
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  benchmark_data <- plot_data %>%
    distinct(
      Panel,
      BenchmarkEstimate
    )

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Plot
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  ggplot(
    plot_data,
    aes(
      x = ReferenceSampleSize,
      y = Value,
      color = Method
    )
  ) +

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Benchmark line
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    geom_hline(
      data = benchmark_data,
      aes(
        yintercept = BenchmarkEstimate
      ),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      linetype = "dashed",
      linewidth = 0.50,
      color = "black"
    ) +

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Points
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    geom_point(
      size = 2.4,
      alpha = 0.95,
      position = position_dodge(
        width = 0.35
      )
    ) +

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Facets
    # --------------------------------------------------------
  facet_wrap(
    ~ Panel,
    ncol = 3,
    scales = "fixed",
    axes = "all",
    axis.labels = "all"
  )+

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Fixed y-axis
    #
    # Slightly below 0 so SAS and Total benchmark lines
    # at y = 0 remain visible.
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    scale_y_continuous(
      limits = c(
        -0.02,
        0.90
      ),
      breaks = c(
        0,
        0.2,
        0.4,
        0.6,
        0.8
      ),
      expand = expansion(
        mult = c(
          0,
          0.02
        )
      )
    ) +

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Method colors
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    scale_color_manual(
      values = method_colors,
      breaks = method_levels,
      labels = method_labels,
      drop = FALSE
    ) +

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Labels
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    labs(
      x = x_axis_title,
      y = "Estimated Ancestry Proportion",
      color = NULL
    ) +

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Figure 2-style theme
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    theme_classic(
      base_size = 14
    ) +

    theme(

     # thin horizontal and vertical grid lines
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(
      color = "grey90",
      linewidth = 0.35
    ),
    
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(
      color = "grey90",
      linewidth = 0.35
    ),
    
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),

      # axes
      axis.line = element_line(
        color = "black",
        linewidth = 0.5
      ),

      axis.title.x = element_text(
        size = 18,
        face = "bold",
        margin = margin(
          t = 10
        )
      ),

      axis.title.y = element_text(
        size = 18,
        face = "bold",
        margin = margin(
          r = 10
        )
      ),

      axis.text.x = element_text(
        size = 13,
        angle = 45,
        hjust = 1,
        vjust = 1,
        face = "bold"
      ),

      axis.text.y = element_text(
        size = 13,
        face = "bold"
      ),

      # facet titles
      strip.background = element_blank(),

      strip.text = element_text(
        size = 14,
        face = "bold"
      ),

      # legend
      legend.position = "bottom",

      legend.title = element_blank(),

      legend.text = element_text(
        size = 12
      ),

      legend.key.width = unit(
        0.8,
        "cm"
      ),

      # white manuscript background
      plot.background = element_rect(
        fill = "white",
        color = NA
      ),

      panel.background = element_rect(
        fill = "white",
        color = NA
      )
    )
}

# ============================================================
# Plot 1
# Real data: jointly limited references
#
# N <= 45:
#   AFR/EUR/IAM/SAS/EAS all use N
#
# N > 45:
#   AFR/EUR/SAS/EAS continue increasing
#   IAM remains capped at N = 45
# ============================================================

real_data_joint_plot <- make_real_data_plot(
  evaluation = real_eval,
  stress_test = "jointly_limited",
  x_axis_title = "Reference sample size (N)"
)

real_data_joint_plot

# ============================================================
# Plot 2
# Real data: AFR varies
#
# AFR = 5 ... 500
# EUR/EAS/SAS = 500
# IAM = 45
# ============================================================

real_data_vary_afr_plot <- make_real_data_plot(
  evaluation = real_eval,
  stress_test = "vary_AFR",
  x_axis_title = "AFR reference sample size (N)"
)

real_data_vary_afr_plot
```
